name: Kafka Studio
description: Operate Apache Kafka from one workspace: inspect topics and partitions, produce and consume messages, filter and decode payloads, monitor consumer lag, manage offsets and ACLs, stream records, and export results.
releaseNotes: 修复深色主题下 Topic 侧栏不可读的问题：图标色随 color-scheme 自动翻转，核心颜色令牌改为实时跟随宿主主题（不再被内联快照冻结），并提升树行/星标对比度。消息查询新增「最近 N 条」Offset 策略并设为默认：原「最新」策略从日志末端只等待新消息，对没有持续流量的 topic 总是「已扫描 0 · 命中 0」，现在默认即可读到每个分区最新的历史记录。Fixed topics sidebar legibility in dark theme: icon hues follow color-scheme, core color tokens now track the host theme live instead of being frozen by an inline snapshot, and tree row/star contrast was raised. Messages query adds a recent-N offset strategy and defaults to it: the previous latest default only waited for new records and always scanned zero on idle topics; the new default surfaces the newest existing records per partition.
